parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.caseId||!b.actor||!['in_progress','resolved','closed_unresolved'].includes(b.status))throw new Error('invalid recovery action');if(['resolved','closed_unresolved'].includes(b.status)&&!b.resolution_code)throw new Error('resolution_code required');return[{json:b}];

parameters.query: WITH c AS (UPDATE recovery_cases SET status=$1,owner=COALESCE(owner,$2),resolution_code=$3,resolution_note=$4,resolved_at=CASE WHEN $1 IN('resolved','closed_unresolved') THEN now() END,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$5 AND status NOT IN('resolved','closed_unresolved') RETURNING id,feedback_id) INSERT INTO audit_log(feedback_id,actor,action,evidence_type,details) SELECT feedback_id,$2,$1,'provider_verified',jsonb_build_object('resolution_code',$3) FROM c RETURNING id;
